tagline: Global leader in HR and payroll solutions with best-in-class HCM technology
hero_kpi_rationale: ADP is a leader in recurring HCM solutions, with revenues primarily driven by stable and predictable subscription contracts, making it the key driver of valuation and structural growth.

kpis.name: Recurring service revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from subscriptions to its HCM software, which are renewable annually.
kpis.description: ADP derives nearly all of its revenue from recurring services (software, outsourced services), ensuring high predictability.
kpis.signal: Strong recurring model with stable growth

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Total revenues of $20,560.9M in 2025, 7% growth in reported and organic constant currency, driven by new subscriptions, customer retention, higher interest income on client funds, and the acquisition of WorkForce Software.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by new subscriptions, retention, and acquisitions

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue (EBIT Margin).
kpis.description: EBIT Margin at 25.8% in 2025 vs 25.4% in 2024, 50 bps expansion; Adjusted EBIT Margin at 26.0% in 2025 vs 25.5% in 2024. Improvement driven by productivity and scale gains.
kpis.signal: Ongoing improvement in operational efficiency through scale benefits

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin calculated as (total revenues minus direct costs) divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Calculated as: (Total Revenues $20,560.9M - Total costs of revenues $11,097.3M) / $20,560.9M = 46.1%. Reflects a highly profitable software/services model.
kpis.signal: Low capital intensity model with high gross margin

kpis.name: R&D investments as percentage of revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D at $988.6M in 2025 vs $955.7M in 2024 (988.6 / 20,560.9 = 4.81%); increasing due to ADP Lyric HCM development, WorkForce Software integration, and deployment of AI tools in R&D.
kpis.signal: Targeted investment in next-generation products and AI

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €53.37B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €9.07B in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €3.35B in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.7 in the latest year

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.399B in the latest year

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 58.8% in the latest year

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $20.561B in the latest year

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income annually, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $4.08B in the latest year

kpis.name: US pays per control (comparable growth)
kpis.explanation: Number of employees on ADP client payrolls in the United States, measured on a comparable basis (same-store-sales).
kpis.description: Pays per control (SSS basis) grew 1% in 2025 vs 2024, indicating modest expansion in existing customer businesses. Key volume metric for Employer Services.
kpis.signal: Modest growth reflecting stability in the U.S. labor market

kpis.name: On-site PEO employees (growth)
kpis.explanation: Average number of employees managed through the PEO service (HR outsourcing).
kpis.description: PEO average worksite employees grew 3% in 2025 vs 2024, driven by demand for integrated HR services and expansion of the PEO segment.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in the PEO HR outsourcing model

kpis.name: Employer Services client revenue retention rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue renewed from existing clients in Employer Services.
kpis.description: ES client revenue retention was 92.1% in 2025, supported by record customer satisfaction scores and sustained loyalty.
kpis.signal: Very high customer loyalty, a key indicator of service quality and satisfaction

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive HCM and payroll solutions market. The dynamic nature of the HCM industry exposes ADP to risks of customer loss and margin erosion.

risks.title: Regulatory and legal compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to a broad range of complex laws and regulations in the U.S. and abroad. Changes in tax laws, withholding rules, data protection, and co-employment regulations could impact its revenues and operational structure.

ai_positioning.summary: ADP mentions efforts to integrate AI into its products and operations, including the deployment of AI tools in its sales, service, and R&D functions to enhance customer experience and drive internal productivity gains.
evidence: Lastly, we continued deploying AI tools in our products and across our sales, service, and research and development functions to improve the client experience and drive internal productivity gains.
our ability to respond successfully to changes in technology, including artificial intelligence
